custody: Both fixed W1 files were fully read, untruncated, and independently byte/SHA/Git hashed. GitHub source bodies below were fully retained and independently hashed in V8. Underlying Go source pins are W1's reported contract evidence, not newly reread by this consumer assessment.

finding.actual: readSnapshot gives Owner [.guest,.reader,.writer,.admin], and marks active non-self/non-Owner members editable without excluding Guest; Admin may edit a non-Admin Guest. The same global list drives both request approval and all editable-member change-role menus.
finding.path: PinkhaSpaceMembersView.memberRow filters only the current role out of grantableRoles. PinkhaSharingMutation.validate(changeRole) checks editableMemberIDs plus grantableRoles, then Native apply sends that role to the existing permissions endpoint.
provenInvalidOffers: Existing Guest -> Reader or Writer (and Admin for an Owner actor): current native validator forbids upgrading an existing Guest.
Existing Writer or Admin -> Guest for an Owner actor: native Guest conversion is limited to a current Reader.
finding.separateUnqualifiedOffer: Owner request-approval menu also includes Guest. W1 does not advertise Guest as an ordinary human invitation grant, but its inspected approval validator does not explicitly reject Guest/None. This report therefore does not call Guest approval a proven native rejection.
finding.unaffected: Owner targets, self targets, non-active targets and Admin targets acted on by an Admin are already excluded. Owner cannot be granted by the shared capability constructor; ownership transfer remains separate.

minimalProposal.preferredScope: A separate Native adapter-only correction, subject to Root's scope decision; no edits made.
changes: Preserve the current eligible moderator/target set for removals.
Derive editableMemberIDs from that set with Guest targets excluded.
Advertise ordinary approval/change roles Owner=[Reader,Writer,Admin], Admin=[Reader,Writer], everyone else=[].
Preserve all current native request bodies, session/lease/account checks, shared UI identifiers, errors, actions and Heart policy.
minimalProposal.explicitTradeoff: Because the existing shared shape has one grantableRoles list for approval and every target, this smallest conservative correction would also remove the currently offered valid Reader->Guest transition from the common UI. It must not be described as complete native role-matrix support.
minimalProposal.preservationAlternative: If Reader->Guest must remain exposed now, use a separately reviewed narrow per-target change-role projection while keeping ordinary approval roles separate. That requires a shared capability/model/UI consumer delta; do not add Guest back globally or change Native APIs.
minimalProposal.regressionObligations: Exercise actual Native capability construction plus mutation validation for Owner/Admin and Guest/Reader/Writer/Admin targets, preserving removability and ordinary Reader/Writer/Admin grants. No tests were created, run or replayed.

contractsThatMatch.requestIdentity: The real pending read retains each native identity and recordId. Approval carries both into the shared mutation, validates the exact row, and sends requestRecordId+permission. Decline intentionally carries identity only and sends only identity.
contractsThatMatch.declineLimit: Fresh client-side re-reading does not create an atomic expected-request-record guarantee. Current Native decline selects JoinRecord(identity) under its own lock; no expected-record fence is claimed.
contractsThatMatch.ordinaryIdentity: The shared row and You marker use actual member.identity, not invitation ID or request record ID. Native expected account is checked through /v1/auth by AnyHTTPClient; W1's ordinary-account equality excludes guest-key identities. No fresh guest-account or account-switch acceptance is inferred.
contractsThatMatch.roleScope: Reader/Writer ordinary grants; only Owner offers Admin; ownership transfer is not exposed as ordinary grant. Heart adapter already delegates member eligibility to original ParticipantSpaceViewData rules and advertises only Reader/Writer/Admin.
contractsThatMatch.postRead: Native apply validates against a newly read snapshot, sends one explicit mutation, then returns another real snapshot. Shared UI checks returned scope. No optimistic role assignment or automatic mutation resend was found.
contractsThatMatch.currentErrorUI: A refresh failure clears snapshot and invitation/control state. A failed action clears snapshot and displays the existing generic unconfirmed-action text with Refresh. Join failure is also generic; typed Native revocation is not uniquely observable from its visible text.
contractsThatMatch.cancellation: Shared view generation retires stale publication and cancels its operation on close. Native operations use the existing session.perform and lease checks; AnyHTTPClient checks expected account before and after requests. These source guards do not invent server-side generation admission on legacy ACL routes.

remainingBoundaries.consumedRequest: W1 identified missing approval/decline sentinel mapping falling through to native500/internal. Its typed404 acl.record_not_found successor is source-only/not run in this handoff. Current AnyHTTPClient preserves HTTP status/code in AnyEngineError.http; do not advertise the future404 or add a guessed universal invite.consumed code.
remainingBoundaries.uncertainty: Shared UI preserves a generic unresolved state and avoids automatic replay, but does not retain a separate pending mutation/ACK record after its task completes. Native apply performs real readback without an explicit per-mutation expected-outcome comparator. This is not full uncertain-mutation recovery or recipient-convergence evidence; no broader design is proposed in this role-only assessment.
remainingBoundaries.legacyAdmission: Native17 account/run routing is not an atomic dispatch contract for the legacy ACL endpoints. Existing client/session fences are not relabeled as one.
remainingBoundaries.historicalFixture: W1's historical HTTP4 receipt e33a4309 and product84a4432a observed owner active and recipient removed/none, with zero membership changes. It is not a fresh approve/decline pair. Approval and decline acceptance need separately owned newly pending requests in a later authorized fixture window.
remainingBoundaries.acceptance: Compiled AX exposure, real recipient approval/decline, valid role transitions, typed failure display/recovery, account/Space changes, unknown-ACK reconciliation and recipient convergence remain unrun here. No HTTP4/old tests, Native account actions, Mac/Apple operations or runtime were invoked.

scope.sourceReads: Two explicitly named ordinary W1 evidence files and seven current full Swift source bodies; bounded directory discovery only.
